title: What I’m doing with the AI that helped prove the Riemann hypothesis
author: chwh_dev
selftext:
Things people have done with AI:

1. Helped prove the Riemann hypothesis.
2. Predicted the shapes of over 200 million proteins.
3. Read a 2,000-year-old scroll without unrolling it.
4. Planned rover drives on Mars.
5. Spotted 800+ previously undocumented objects in Hubble images.
6. Detected 29% more breast cancers in a screening trial.
7. Designed antibiotic candidates that worked against drug-resistant bacteria in mice.
8. Predicted where Hurricane Melissa would make landfall.
9. Broke a 56-year-old record for multiplying 4×4 complex matrices.
10. Built a robot that beat professional table tennis players.

And Me. I’m making a game where I can do the things I can’t do in real life.

I love dating sims.

This is aigamedev, you're building games with AI...

I don't mind this post and who the fuck cares. People should just build what they want to build and that's good and exactly what AI is for.

comments.body: Sorry if the joke fell flat. The game is real, though! I’ve been working on it after work for the past three months.
